verses.en: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
verses.sm: Ua mavae ia mea, ona maliu atu lea o Iesu i le tasi itu o le vai o Kalilaia, o le vai lea o Tiperia.

verses.en: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
verses.sm: Ona mulimuli atu lea ia te ia le motu O tagata e toatele, aua na latou matamata i ona faailoga sa faia i e na mamai.

verses.en: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
verses.sm: Ua maliu ae Iesu i le mauga, ua nofo i lalo, o ia ma ona soo.

verses.en: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.
verses.sm: Ua latalata le paseka, o le tausamiga lea o Iutaia.

verses.en: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
verses.sm: Ona tepa ae ai lea o lesu ona fofoga, ua silasila atu foi, ua o mai ia te ia le motu o tagata e toatele, Ona fetalai atu lea o ia ia Filipo, “O ifea tatou te faatauina mai ai ni areto, ina ia aai ai i latou nei?”

verses.en: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
verses.sm: Ua faapea atu Iesu, o lana tofotofo ia te ia, aua ua silafia lava e ia le mea o le a na faia.

verses.en: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
verses.sm: Ua tali mai Filipo ia te ia, “E le lava areto, pe a faatauina i !tenari e lua selau, ina ia tofu i latou ma sina mea itiiti.”

verses.en: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea ia te ia o le tasi o ona soo, o Aneterea, o le uso O Simona Peteru,

verses.en: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
verses.sm: “O loo iinei le tama O ia te la areto karite e lima, ma nai iʻa iti e lua lau; a e awta ea ia mea ia i latou e toatele?”

verses.en: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
verses.sm: Ona faapea atu lea o Iesu, “Ta outou fai ane ia taooto tagata.” E tele foi le mutia i lea mea. Ona latou taooto ai lea, o le tau aofai o tane, pe lima o afe.

verses.en: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
verses.sm: Ona tago lea O Iesu i areto, ua faafetai, ona tufa18: 28. tufa lea i e taooto. Ua faapea foi ma iʻa, ua avatu faitalia i latou.

verses.en: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
verses.sm: Ua maoona lava i latou, ona fetalai ane lea o ia i ona soo, ia faapotopoto toe ‘aiga, neʻi ai ni mea e maumau.

verses.en: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
verses.sm: Ona faapotopoto ai lea, ua tutumu ai “ato e sefulu ma le lua i toe “aiga o areto karite e lima, o mea ia na totoe i e na aai.

verses.en: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e ia tagata le faailoga na faia e Iesu, ona faapea lea o i latou, “E moni, o lea lava perofeta lenei, o i maliu mai i le lalolagi.”

verses.en: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
verses.sm: Ua silafia foi e Iesu, o le a o mai i latou e pue ia te ia, ina ia latou faia o ia ma tupu, ona toe maliu ese ai lea o ia e toatasi i le mauga.

verses.en: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
verses.sm: Ua oo i le afiafi, ona o ifo lea o ona soo i le vai,

verses.en: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.
verses.sm: ua o ae foi i le vaa, ona latou o lea i Kapanaumi i le tasi itu o le vai. Ua pouliuli foi, a e lei maliu atu lava Iesu ia te i latou.

verses.en: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
verses.sm: Ua sousou foi le vai i le matagi ua agi tetele.

verses.en: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
verses.sm: Ua taualo i latou, pe tolu pe fa maila, ona iloa atu lea o i latou ia Iesu, o savali lava i luga o le vai, ua latalata atu foi o ia i le vaa; ua latou fefefe ai.

verses.en: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
verses.sm: A ua fetalai atu ia ia te i latou, “O aʻu lava lenei; “aua tou te fefefe.”

verses.en: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
verses.sm: Sa latou fia talia o ia i le vaa, a e oo atu loa lea o le vaa i le nuu ua latou o iai.

verses.en: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
verses.sm: O le taeao ua iloa ai e le motu o tagata, e na tutū i le tasi itu O le vai, ua leai se tasi vaa i lea mea, na o lea na o ai ona soo, e lei O faatasi foi o Iesu ma ona soo i le vaa, na o ona soo lava na 6 ai;

verses.en: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
verses.sm: a ua o mai nisi vaa nai Tiperia, e lata ane i le mea na latou aai ai, ina ua faafetai e le Alii.

verses.en: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e le motu o tagata e lei i ai Iesu, e lei i ai foi ona 500, ona o ai lea o i latou foi i vaa, ma o atu i Kapanaumi, o saili ia lesu.

verses.en: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
verses.sm: Чa iloa o ia e i latou i le tasi itu o le vai, ona faapea mai lea o i latou ia te ja, “Rapi e, na e maliu mai ea linei anafea?”

verses.en: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
verses.sm: Ua tali atu Iesu ia te i latou, “E moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, e lei saili mai outou ia te au, aua na outou vaai mai i faailoga, a e peitai ua outou aai i areto, ma outou maoona ai.

verses.en: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.
verses.sm: “Aua tou te galulue i mea e “ai e pala, a o mea e ‘ai e tumau i le ola faavavau, e foaiina atu ia te outou e le Atalii o le tagata; aua ua faaalitinoina mai o ia e le Atua le Tama.”

verses.en: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?
verses.sm: Ona faapea mai lea o i latou ia te ia, “Se a se mea matou te faia, ina ia matou galulue i galuega a le Atua?”

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
verses.sm: Ua tali atu Iesu ia te i latou, “O lenei le galuega a le Atua, ia outou faatuatua ia te ia ua auina mai e ia.”

verses.en: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?
verses.sm: Ona faapea mai lea o i latou ia te ia, “Se a se faailoga e te faia matou te vaai atu i ai, ma faatuatua ai ia te oe? Se a se galuega e te faia?

verses.en: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
verses.sm: Na aai e o matou tama le manai i le vao, faapei ona tusia, Na ia avatua ia te i latou le areto mai le lagi e aai ai.”

verses.en: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te i latou, “E moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, e le o Mose na avatu la te outou lena areto mai le lagi; peitai o lo'u Tama, na te avatu ia te outou le areto moni mai le lagi;

verses.en: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
verses.sm: aua o le areto mai le Atua, a le tosina mai e le Tama ua auina O le mea ua alu ifo mai ie lagi lea, ma au mai le ola i le lalolagi.”

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o i latou ia te ia, “Le Alii e, au mai ia te i matou lena areto, “aua le aunoa.”

verses.en: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu Iesu ia te i latou, “O a'u nei le areto o le ola; o lé sau ia te au, e le fia “ai lava ia; o lē faatuatua foi ia te au, e le toe fia inu lava ia.

verses.en: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.
verses.sm: A ua ou fai atu ia te outou, ua outou vaavaai mai ia te au, a e tou te lei faatuatua mai lava.

verses.en: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
verses.sm: O i latou uma ua foaiina mai ia te au e le Tama, e o mai i latou ia te au; o ia foi e sau ia te au, ou te le tulia lava i fafo.

verses.en: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
verses.sm: Aua ou te lei alu ifo mai le lagi e fai loʻu lava loto, a o le finagalo o le ua awna mai a'u.

verses.en: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
verses.sm: O lenei foi le finagalo o le Tama o le ua auina mai aʻu, ia le máumau lava se tasi ua ia foaiina mai ia te au, a ia ou toe faatuina o ia i le aso gataaga.

verses.en: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.sm: O lenei foi le finagalo o le ua awna mai aʻu, ia maua le ola faavavau e i latou uma O e vaai i le Atalii, ma faatuatua ia te ia, ou te toe faatuina foi i latou i le aso gataaga.”

verses.en: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
verses.sm: Ona muimui ai lea ia te ia o lutaia, auá ua fetalai atu ja, “O a'u le areto ua alu ifo mai le lagi;”

verses.en: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?
verses.sm: ua faapea ane foi i latou, “E le o Iesu ea lenei le atalii o Iosefa, ua tatou iloa lona tama ma lona tina? O lenei foi, pe faapefea ona fai mai o ia, ua ou alu ifo mai le lagi?”

verses.en: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o Iesu ia te i latou, “Aua tou te muimui.

verses.en: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.sm: E le mafai se rasi ona sau ia te au, pe mai a'u; ou te toe faatuina foi o ia i le aso gataaga.

verses.en: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.
verses.sm: Ua tusia i le au perofeta, E aʻoaʻoina i latou uma lava e le Atua. O lenei, o i latou uma o e faalogo i le Tama, o e a'oa'oina foi, e o mai i latou ia te au;

verses.en: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.
verses.sm: a e le ona ua vaai se tasi i le Tama; na o ia mai le Tama, ua vaai atu lava ia i le Tama.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, O lé faatuatua mai ia te au, ua ia te ia le ola faavavau.

verses.en: I am that bread of life.
verses.sm: O aʻu o le areto o le ola.

verses.en: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
verses.sm: Na aai e o outou tama le manai i le vao, a ua oti i latou.

verses.en: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
verses.sm: O lenei le areto ua alu ifo mai le lagi; ai se ‘ai ai ona le oti lea o ia.

verses.en: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.
verses.sm: O aʻu le areto ola na alu ifo mai le lagi; pe a ‘ai se tasi i lenei areto, ona ola ai lea o ia e faavavau. O le areto foi ou te avatua, o lo'u tino lea, ou te avatua ma ola o le lalolagi.”

verses.en: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
verses.sm: Ona fefinauai ai lea o Iutaia, ua faapea ane, “E mafai faapefea e lenei tagata ona au mai o lona tino ia te i tatou, tatou te aai ai?”

verses.en: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te i latou, “E moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, afai tou te le aai i le tino o le Atalii o le tagata, a le inu foi i lona toto, ua le i totonu ia te outou le ola.

verses.en: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.sm: O lē ‘ai i loʻu tino ma inu i loʻu toto, ua ia te ia le ola faavavau; ou te toe faatuina foi o ia i le aso gataaga;

verses.en: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
verses.sm: aua o lo'u tino o le mea e ‘ai moni lea, o lo‘u toto foi o le mea e inu moni lea.

verses.en: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.
verses.sm: O lē ‘ai i loʻu tino ma inu i loʻu toto, e tumau o ia la te au, o aʻu foi ia te ia.

verses.en: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.
verses.sm: E faapei ona soifua o le Tama ua na awna mai aʻu, o loo ola foi aʻu i le Tama; e faapea foi o lé “ai ia te au, e ola lea ia te au.

verses.en: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.
verses.sm: O lenei le areto ua alu ifo mai le lagi, e le pei o outou tama na aai le manai, a ua oti i latou; o le “ai i lenei areto e ola ia e faavavau lava.”

verses.en: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
verses.sm: O mea ja na fetalai ai Iesu ina o aʻoaʻo o ia i le sunako i Kapanaumi.

verses.en: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
verses.sm: Ua faalogologo ai isi ona soo e toatele, ona faapea ai lea o i latou, “O le upu faigata lena; o ai ea se na te mafaia ona faalogologo i ai?”

verses.en: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?
verses.sm: Ua silafia e Iesu i lona lava finagalo, ua muimui ona soo i lena mea, ona fetalai atu ai lea o ia ia te i latou, “Tou te tausuai ea i lena mea?

verses.en: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
verses.sm: Pe faapefea pe a outou vaai atu i le Atalii o le tagata, o alu ae ia i le mea sa i ai anamua?

verses.en: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
verses.sm: O le agaga lea e tupu ai le ola, e le aoga le tino i se mea; o upu ou te fai atu ia te outou, o le agaga Ja, O le ola foi ia.

verses.en: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
verses.sm: Peitai o isi o outou e le faatuatua lava;” aua ua silafia e Iesu talu lava le amataga o isi o e na le faatuatua, ma le tasi na te faalataina o ia.

verses.en: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.
verses.sm: Ua ia fetalai atu foi, “O le mea lea na ou fai atu ai ia te outou, e le mafai e se tasi ona sau ia te au, pea le foaiina atu ai ia te ia e lo'u Tama.”

verses.en: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
verses.sm: Talu ai ua o ese isi o ona soo e toatele i tua, a e lei toe feoai i latou ma ia.

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?
verses.sm: Ona faapea atu lea o lesu i le toasefulu ma le toalua, “Pe tou te fia o ese foi?”

verses.en: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o Simona Peteru ia te ia, “Le Alii e, a matou o ea ia te ai? O ia te oe upu o le ola faavavau.

verses.en: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.
verses.sm: Ua matou talitonu, ma ua matou iloa o oe o le Paia o le Atua.”

verses.en: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?
verses.sm: Ua tali atu lesu ia te i latou, “Na ou le filifilia ea outou e toasefulu ma le toalua? A o le tasi o outou o le tiapolo ia.”

verses.en: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu ai o ia ia Iuta le atalii o Simona le Sekara; aua o ia o le a na faalataina o ia, o le tasi foi lea o le toasefulu ma le toalua.
